summary: This TOML configuration defines a single runner that uses Docker as its executor, and specifies that Docker jobs should run using the php8.4 image. It's setting up a GitLab CI runner (or similar CI system) to spin up PHP 8.4 containers when running jobs.

explanations.1: The double brackets [[runners]] create an array of runner configurations; this is the first entry in that array.
explanations.5: The double brackets [[runners.docker]] create a nested array under the current runner, allowing you to define multiple Docker configurations for this runner.
explanations.7: This specifies which Docker image to pull and use as the container for running CI jobs — in this case, php8.4.
